games.description: Two solo visits to PsychoHypnotic’s Christmas horror game. Sark recovers 42 presents, unlocks the reindeer route, survives Santa and snowmen, and returns months later for another normal-difficulty clear.
games.title: Backrooms Santa

games.description: A short solo sample of MachNone’s comedy fantasy RPG. Sark receives the Phoenix blade, wrestles with dropping and equipping it, and tries the forest combat and early talents before leaving the adventure unfinished.
games.title: Dragon Knight

games.description: Sark samples the Italian western’s characters, shootouts and short platforming stages. Repeated continues carry him through bosses before a broken zeppelin encounter stops the run.
games.title: Olive Raiders

games.description: Sark makes dialogue and romance choices as Atlas, spends time with Oscar’s family and investigates the threat following the sisters. The awkward drama culminates in a violent confrontation and an ending he immediately checks against the available achievements.
